limitations: Model-assisted labels, not human ground truth.
Bounded views can miss content between recorded windows.
Rates are unweighted on a balanced, capacity-capped cache sample; they do not establish corpus prevalence.
Grouping uses exact visible-content hashes; near duplicates can cross splits.
The same independent model also adjudicates in fresh contexts.
Astra used the initial rubric; GLM continuation explicitly excludes universal tokenizer wrappers as evidence.
